baseline.note: Entries describe verified repository state. A CLOSED entry must cite evidence that exists; an EXTERNAL_GATE entry names its owner and the exact missing proof. Nothing here is a readiness claim.

entries.capability: Provider subject to internal principal binding
entries.defect: The approved legacy Drizzle bootstrap does not create platform_identity_bindings, the nzila_auth_* roles or the reader-owned definer predicates; migration 0041 is unapplied to every durable environment, so production identity cannot run on the approved path.
entries.securityImplications: Until adopted, authenticated provider sessions cannot be resolved to an internal principal by the supported path.
entries.requiredImplementation: Adopt 0041 (or the v2 bootstrap) through the governed migration process on a non-production clone and fold the extra membership function into the auth-storage-authority catalog verifier.

entries.defect: A second provider-binding reader inside the authority kernel read a table no business role may read and enumerated memberships outside the supported organization selection.
entries.securityImplications: Duplicate identity authority; bypass of the dedicated provider execution context.
entries.requiredImplementation: Consume the verified binding instead.

entries.capability: Cross-principal membership reads under the v2 topology
entries.defect: compileAuthorityMembershipReaderSql() exists in the kernel but is not adopted into the auth-storage-authority compiler or its catalog verifier.
entries.securityImplications: A definer function installed outside the verifier would be an unreviewed privileged reader.
entries.requiredImplementation: Move the function into org-session-authority.ts, add it to AUTH_FUNCTION_EXPECTATIONS, and prove fixed search_path, ownership, grants and caller confinement in the native auth proof.

entries.capability: Session bearer exposure through PostgreSQL session settings
entries.defect: The raw server-held session bearer is placed in a transaction-local PostgreSQL setting so definer predicates can hash it in-database. Exposure paths (statement logging, pg_stat_activity parameters, pooled-connection reuse, diagnostics) have not been reviewed.
entries.securityImplications: A credential in a server setting can leak into logs or be read by a same-session query.
entries.requiredImplementation: Review and prove transaction-local scope and non-disclosure; where compatible, bind a derived proof instead of the raw bearer.

entries.defect: Three membership records coexist. The kernel and the v2 predicates read the compatibility projection; the platform resolver targets the canonical table, which needs the shared orgs table.
entries.securityImplications: Drift between projection and canonical membership can grant or deny wrongly.
entries.requiredImplementation: Define the migration and a reconciliation check between the projection and the canonical table; move readers once the canonical table is deployed.

entries.defect: Provider code, packages, credentials and seed were removed; remaining references are the documented webhook alias, Whop legacy metadata, legacy-env detection, historical migrations, the unrelated Admin Clerk office role, and the physical column name clerk_user_id.
entries.securityImplications: Legacy webhook header and env names are detection-only; the physical column name is cosmetic but misleading.
entries.requiredImplementation: Forward migration renaming clerk_user_id to auth_user_id across user_uuid_mapping consumers; retire the webhook alias and Whop key once their external consumers are confirmed.

entries.capability: Webhook, Whop and test-credential external actions
entries.defect: The auth webhook secret is provisioned but no sender exists in the repository; Whop consumer unknown; roughly 45 staging accounts used a repo-known test password.
entries.securityImplications: A known password may still be accepted by staging accounts.
entries.requiredImplementation: External actions only.

externalGate.owner: identity operations; integration owners; billing integration
externalGate.missingProof: Dated evidence that the old password is rejected or the accounts disabled; identity of the webhook sender and a delivery log; confirmation that the Whop consumer reads userId only.

entries.defect: union_rep_id is a mutable uuid with no foreign key, read as a principal id by 28 files; four competing assignment records exist and grievance_assignments is keyed to the legacy claims model.
entries.securityImplications: Any route that updates a grievance can reassign ownership and silently change authority.
entries.requiredImplementation: Run reconcileCaseOwnership per organization, backfill through assignCase, migrate consumers to the kernel, then retire the column as an authority source.

entries.capability: Case unit, territory and respondent sources
entries.canonicalOwner: to be decided with the grievance domain owner
entries.defect: grievances has no unit, territory or respondent columns (employer_id, workplace_id and cba_id are not verified bargaining units); unit- and territory-scoped supervisory mandates reach no case and no respondent is excluded as adverse.
entries.securityImplications: Conflict-of-interest exclusion cannot protect a respondent.
entries.requiredImplementation: Add forward-compatible unit_id, territory_id and a case_respondents relation with referential integrity and a backfill plan; load them in loadCase.

entries.defect: Django grievance_assignments, documents and transitions reference the legacy claims model while the case policy and document links reference grievances.
entries.securityImplications: A bare 'case' document link may mean a claim; access cannot be derived from it.
entries.requiredImplementation: Choose and document the case entity, migrate or retire the competing one.

entries.canonicalOwner: to be decided with the finance domain owner
entries.defect: The deployed payments relation has no amount, currency or payer; no relation anywhere carries approver or executor actors for disbursements.
entries.securityImplications: Money authority cannot be authorized from missing records; the kernel correctly denies.
entries.requiredImplementation: Decide the disbursement and approval entity; implement and deploy it with RLS; enable finance actions only where amount, currency and workflow actors exist.

entries.canonicalOwner: to be decided with the finance domain owner
entries.defect: The only real approval workflow (expense_requests, expense_approvals, vendors) lives in services/financial-service, which has no deployment path and is classified LATENT_UNREACHABLE; 11 of its tables were never migrated.
entries.securityImplications: Financial approvals cannot be audited or segregated in the deployed system.
entries.requiredImplementation: Either deploy financial-service under the kernel or implement approvals in the canonical owner; retire the loser.

retirement.replacement: the finance approval entity chosen under UE-CONV-D-001

entries.capability: Legacy case and document authorization shortcuts
entries.defect: isStewardPlus and case_read_any style rank checks remain in 15 files (9 routes and 5 services).
entries.securityImplications: Cross-case access derived from seniority.
entries.requiredImplementation: Migrate each consumer to the kernel and delete the helpers; the ratchet forbids new uses.

entries.capability: Internal-file scope derived from a legacy flag
entries.defect: The loader derived read_internal from can_edit_case_notes, coupling reading and editing. Fixed: a legacy flag now yields read/comment/write only; read_internal is an explicit kernel grant under the case_assignment rule. The write permission still derives from the legacy flag until the assignment table itself is retired (UE-CONV-B-001).
entries.securityImplications: Granting edit rights silently disclosed the union's working file.
entries.requiredImplementation: Reading, editing and disclosure are separate; the internal scope is an explicit governed grant.

entries.defect: Versioning, access review, consent-based sharing, withdrawal, retention, export and portability, access requests and disclosure history are not implemented against the classification model.
entries.securityImplications: Disclosure cannot be audited per document.
entries.requiredImplementation: Implement the lifecycle on the classification and kernel contracts.

entries.defect: The default policy is provisional and unapproved by design.
entries.securityImplications: None: the default releases nothing to a member except their own submissions.
entries.requiredImplementation: A configurable, approval-gated policy adoption workflow exists in code; adoption itself is institutional.

externalGate.missingProof: An approved instrument naming member-disclosable labels and the third-party definition.

entries.capability: Counsel engagement and verified counsel authentication
entries.canonicalOwner: kernel counsel boundary (to be completed) with an external counsel-side verifier
entries.defect: Only an assertion-envelope validator exists; there is no matter-specific engagement record, nonce store or verifier port, and a blanket exclusion of union members replaced a proper separate-capacity and conflict model.
entries.securityImplications: Counsel acceptance must be unforgeable by a union principal and independent of union permissions.
entries.requiredImplementation: Engagement register, replay-proof nonce store, verifier port, conflict and isolation model.

entries.canonicalOwner: agents/workaid-prep-20261023 (184 changed paths, docs and tooling only)
entries.defect: The WorkAid candidate is analysis and synthetic reproduction only and is unmerged; its proposed tables depend on an unqualified migration journal.
entries.securityImplications: None until merged.
entries.requiredImplementation: Assess slices against the kernel contract and implement the legal-matter domain on it.

entries.defect: Thirteen routes returned 200 { status: 'accepted' } and an empty list as a status without doing or recording work, including CLC remittance submit and member merge.
entries.securityImplications: A financial submission was reported as accepted when nothing was submitted.
entries.requiredImplementation: Honest 501s now; each underlying capability is its own implementation item.

entries.capability: Implementation of the thirteen stubbed operations
entries.canonicalOwner: domain owners per capability registry entries UE-ACTION-*
entries.defect: Member merge, bulk, exports, CLC remittance submit and export, CRA export, communications exports and alert test execution are not implemented; UI surfaces now show an honest error.
entries.securityImplications: Several are consequential (member PII export, financial submission) and need kernel authorization and audit first.
entries.requiredImplementation: Implement each on the canonical contracts, or hide the surface with a recorded product decision.

entries.defect: package.json exposes db:bootstrap, db:migrate, db:migrate:legacy, db:scoped-migrate:existing and db:push (drizzle-kit push, which bypasses the migration ledger) alongside the Django lineage and the prospective v2 installer.
entries.securityImplications: db:push can alter a schema outside the approved lineage.
entries.requiredImplementation: Classify each entrypoint, retire db:push and the legacy migrate path after consumer check, and designate one installation path.

entries.capability: Misleading architecture guidance and multi-database client
entries.defect: Comments describe Supabase auth and a SQL Server abstraction in a PostgreSQL-only system; db/db.ts imports the multi-database client.
entries.securityImplications: Dead branches and wrong guidance obscure the real database path.
entries.requiredImplementation: Verify non-PostgreSQL paths are unreachable, remove them, correct the comments.

entries.capability: Seed data targets a column and tenant-id format the supported lineage no longer has
entries.defect: seed-master.sql writes organizations.clerk_organization_id and keys its four core tenants by Clerk-format ids, while auth_core 0003 renames that column to auth_provider_org_id in the Django lineage and the Clerk provider is retired.
entries.securityImplications: A seed that runs only on the legacy baseline hides drift between lineages; Clerk-format ids imply a provider that no longer exists.
entries.requiredImplementation: Re-author the seed against the canonical organizations contract and run it through the supported replay on PostgreSQL 15 and 16.

retirement.replacement: seed authored against the canonical organizations contract

entries.defect: Two scratch scripts carried hard-coded local database credentials and a third ran drizzle-kit push, auto-answering No to destructive prompts; none had any reference.
entries.securityImplications: Credentials in source and a ledger-bypassing schema push.
entries.requiredImplementation: Remove.

entries.capability: Six frozen persona candidates and the Steward experience
entries.canonicalOwner: integration branch against the kernel contract
entries.defect: None of the persona branches is integrated; they encode conflicting role-hierarchy authorization (case_read_any, isStewardPlus, differing financial thresholds). Another agent is advancing fix/ue-global-experience-convergence in a separate worktree.
entries.securityImplications: Merging them as-is would reintroduce rank-derived authority.
entries.requiredImplementation: Integrate persona by persona against the kernel with route-level positive and negative tests; do not select by recency.

entries.capability: Staging clone qualification of kernel migrations
entries.defect: 0013_authority_kernel_storage and 0020_authority_kernel_rls_closure are registered UNQUALIFIED and have not been applied to a staging clone.
entries.securityImplications: Unqualified schema in the deployment path.
entries.requiredImplementation: Run the clone-qualification gate.

externalGate.missingProof: Clone-qualification gate output for the registered additions.

entries.defect: Previously absent; the approved set was hard-coded.
entries.securityImplications: Detects unauthorised alteration, omission or reordering of approved migrations.
entries.requiredImplementation: Run in CI through the convergence checker.

entries.defect: The scaffold fake-success pattern was not detected.
entries.securityImplications: Prevents recurrence of fake success.
entries.requiredImplementation: Rule R-9, enforced as an error.

entries.defect: No machine check existed that the register is truthful, that retired symbols stay retired, or that legacy shortcuts do not grow.
entries.securityImplications: Prevents reconciliation debt from silently returning.
entries.requiredImplementation: Checker with register validation and ratchets, run in the validation chain.

entries.capability: Persona action coverage, authorization coverage, documentation supersession and cleanroom deployment proof
entries.defect: No check fails qualification when a required persona action has no route, policy and persistence; no check rejects active documentation that references retired architecture; no fresh-environment install proof runs in CI.
entries.securityImplications: Fake completion remains possible for these classes.
entries.requiredImplementation: Build each control against the persona matrix once the matrix is machine-readable.
